content: ⌊ DRAFT g In case the resource does not support multiple noti- fier sets, but uses Notifier Handles , the Software Cluster Connector shall detect if for a machine a resource with the identical resource type id and identical global resource Id is required more than one time. In this case, the connection process for this specific machine shall be aborted.
